summary: Built lab-scan-target:latest (FROM debian:buster-slim, EOL Debian 10) in the sandbox engine and scanned it with trivy 0.76.2 and grype 0.122.1. Reconciled 136 unique CVE/package pairs: 66 seen by both scanners, 1 only by trivy, 69 only by grype. 17 CVEs rate high or critical by union severity (2 critical); 8 pairs have a published fix (libc6 2.28-10+deb10u4). Not covered: the image runs no language-level packages (OS packages only), and debian-10 is end of life, so distro-tracker coverage is partial.

tools_run.name: trivy
tools_run.command: trivy image --scanners vuln --skip-version-check --skip-db-update --format json --output evidence/artifacts/trivy.json lab-scan-target:latest

tools_run.name: grype
tools_run.command: GRYPE_CHECK_FOR_APP_UPDATE=false GRYPE_DB_AUTO_UPDATE=false grype docker:lab-scan-target:latest -o json --file evidence/artifacts/grype.json

hypotheses.title: grype reports 69 pairs trivy does not see; trivy reports 1 pair alone
hypotheses.rationale: Scanner databases cover different namespaces: grype's Debian tracker data lists many more debian-10 packages than trivy's feed. The single trivy-only pair is zlib1g CVE-2023-45853. A lone high/critical sighting still counts as a finding; the bulk divergence is recorded here, not per pair.
hypotheses.next_step: When a fix decision matters for a divergent CVE, read the distro tracker page linked in the report's dataSource.

hypotheses.title: Base image debian-10 is end of life; grype warns coverage may be incomplete
hypotheses.rationale: grype printed '14 packages from EOL distro - vulnerability data may be incomplete or outdated'. EOL images also receive no new fixes, which is why only 8 of 136 pairs are fixable.
hypotheses.next_step: Rebuild on a supported base image and re-scan; expect the fixable share to rise.
